I study how people use urban space, how commercial districts change, and how housing markets work. My work combines spatial and econometric methods with sensing, administrative, and online platform data, with particular attention to measurement, validation, and policy applications.

## Software

**urban-wifi-sensing-toolkit** is an open-source R toolkit covering the full WiFi sensing pipeline for urban research, from sensor construction and data collection to urban metrics. [Online book](https://juhyeonpark.com/urban-wifi-sensing-toolkit/){.pub} [GitHub](https://github.com/urbanjuhyeon/urban-wifi-sensing-toolkit){.pub} [https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21442378](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21442378){.pub}
